description: Germany only. Calculate the deadline for an unfair dismissal claim (Klagefrist, Kündigungsschutzklage) in Germany: 3 weeks after the written notice was received (§ 4 KSchG), moved to the next working day if it ends on a weekend or public holiday (§ 222 Abs. 2 ZPO). Applies in small businesses too. Use it to know from when a dismissal can be treated as final.
